svg.title: One Annual Cohort, Five Nested Conversion Stages
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-account-to-acceptance-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: One Annual Cohort, Five Nested Conversion Stages; subtitle: An illustrative 5,000-account cohort produces 60 client-accepted appointments without counting messages as separate prospects.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: All stages count distinct accounts from one annual cohort; each later stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Count at most one accepted appointment per account. These are planning assumptions, not observed conversion benchmarks. Sixty accepted appointments at $1,000 produce $60,000; five annual client retainers at $73,000 produce $365,000; combined Base revenue is exactly $425,000.; caption: Stage conversions are 40%, 10%, 40%, and 75%; total accepted yield is 1.2% of screened accounts. Retainers are a separate revenue component, not an additional prospect-conversion stage.; stages: label: Eligible target accounts; value: 5,000 distinct accounts meet documented screening criteria.; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Deduplicate company domains and legal entities, confirm commercial fit, and remove suppressed contacts before including an account in the annual eligible cohort.; label: Accounts reached; value: 2,000 accounts receive at least one eligible outreach.; numeric value: 2000.0; detail: Forty percent of screened accounts receive a delivered message through an eligible channel. Multiple contacts, inboxes, and follow-ups still count as one reached account.; label: Positive account responses; value: 200 accounts express interest in a relevant conversation.; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Ten percent of reached accounts provide a positive human response. Exclude automatic replies, unsubscribe requests, wrong-person referrals without interest, and duplicate threads.; label: Held qualified appointments; value: 80 accounts complete conversations meeting the qualification rubric.; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Forty percent of positive accounts attend a conversation with verified territory, commercial need, and buyer role. Exclude cancellations, no-shows, and merely booked meetings.; label: Client-accepted appointments; value: 60 accounts produce accepted units worth $60,000 annually.; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Clients accept seventy-five percent of held qualified appointments under written criteria. Bill $1,000 per accepted unit; track the twenty rejected units separately.

text.title: One Annual Cohort, Five Nested Conversion Stages
text.tspan: One Annual Cohort, Five Nested Conversion Stages

rect.title: label: Eligible target accounts; value: 5,000 distinct accounts meet documented screening criteria.; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Deduplicate company domains and legal entities, confirm commercial fit, and remove suppressed contacts before including an account in the annual eligible cohort.

label: Accounts reached; value: 2,000 accounts receive at least one eligible outreach.; numeric value: 2000.0; detail: Forty percent of screened accounts receive a delivered message through an eligible channel. Multiple contacts, inboxes, and follow-ups still count as one reached account.

label: Positive account responses; value: 200 accounts express interest in a relevant conversation.; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Ten percent of reached accounts provide a positive human response. Exclude automatic replies, unsubscribe requests, wrong-person referrals without interest, and duplicate threads.

label: Held qualified appointments; value: 80 accounts complete conversations meeting the qualification rubric.; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Forty percent of positive accounts attend a conversation with verified territory, commercial need, and buyer role. Exclude cancellations, no-shows, and merely booked meetings.

label: Client-accepted appointments; value: 60 accounts produce accepted units worth $60,000 annually.; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Clients accept seventy-five percent of held qualified appointments under written criteria. Bill $1,000 per accepted unit; track the twenty rejected units separately.

text.title: Assumptions: All stages count distinct accounts from one annual cohort; each later stage is a subset of the preceding stage. Count at most one accepted appointment per account. These are planning assumptions, not observed conversion benchmarks. Sixty accepted appointments at $1,000 produce $60,000; five annual client retainers at $73,000 produce $365,000; combined Base revenue is exactly $425,000.
